charaepi_ch0346_00_kihada/2301_1101_100_:
[Name:PlayerNickname ] was
accompanying Dendra on a run across Pasio.
charaepi_ch0346_00_kihada/2301_1201_100_: Phew! That was a good workout!
charaepi_ch0346_00_kihada/2301_1201_200_:
You’ve got a good pair of legs on ya,
[Name:PlayerNickname ]!
charaepi_ch0346_00_kihada/2301_1201_300_:
I couldn’t help getting fired up over how
good it felt to run...
charaepi_ch0346_00_kihada/2301_1201_400_: but are you OK keeping this pace?
charaepi_ch0346_00_kihada/2301_0401_200_:
But I can tell you’re pushing yourself too
hard. You can’t fool a teacher!
charaepi_ch0346_00_kihada/2301_1201_500_: Let’s pick this up another time!
charaepi_ch0346_00_kihada/2301_1201_600_:
Give me a shout anytime you want to build
stamina!
charaepi_ch0346_00_kihada/2301_1201_700_: Sounds like Medicham will support us again!
charaepi_ch0346_00_kihada/2301_1201_800_:
She always keeps me company when I’m
strength training or out on a run.
charaepi_ch0346_00_kihada/2301_1201_1000:
so they make good partners who’ll cheer you
on when you’re exercising!
charaepi_ch0346_00_kihada/2301_1201_1100:
Of course, I also rely on mine in Pokémon
battles!
charaepi_ch0346_00_kihada/2301_1201_1200:
Medicham’s advantage against Psychic-type
Pokémon is greater than other Fighting
types’!
charaepi_ch0346_00_kihada/2301_1201_1300:
After all, Medicham is both Fighting type and
Psychic type.
charaepi_ch0346_00_kihada/2301_1201_1400:
There aren’t many matchups that’d put her
at a disadvantage. I don’t have to worry
about sending her out!
charaepi_ch0346_00_kihada/2301_1201_1600:
Even when our weaknesses are covered,
some opponents are still too strong.
charaepi_ch0346_00_kihada/2301_1201_1800:
As a battle studies teacher, I gotta get so
strong, I lose to no one!
charaepi_ch0346_00_kihada/2301_1201_2000:
I’ve a ways to go! I’ve got to hone my spirit
just like Medicham!
charaepi_ch0346_00_kihada/2301_1201_2100:
[Name:PlayerNickname ]! Let’s do lots
of training and battling together!
charaepi_ch0346_00_kihada/2301_1201_2200:
We’ll train ourselves inside and out for
a strong mind and a strong body!
